title: President appoints commission to resolve public sector salary, pension disputes
summary: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has issued an Extraordinary Gazette appointing a 15-member commission to recommend solutions to long-standing disputes concerning the salaries and pensions of government employees.

title: Tehran’s chief negotiator: Strait of Hormuz won’t return to pre-war status
summary: Conditions in the Strait of Hormuz “will never go back to the way they were before the war,” Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf vowed on Monday.

title: Congo says confirmed Ebola cases rise to 1,048, including 267 deaths
summary: The Democratic Republic of ‌Congo said late on Monday that confirmed ⁠Ebola cases in the country had reached 1,048, including 267 deaths.

title: Over 500 GN divisions in 14 districts declared high-risk dengue zones
summary: A total of 538 Grama Niladhari (GN) divisions across 14 districts have been declared high-risk dengue zones as Sri Lanka steps up efforts to control the rapid spread of the mosquito-borne disease.

title: MPs try to grab mace
summary: Several Opposition MPs including Ajith P. Perera, Dayasiri Jayasekera and a few others tried to grab the mace but were stopped by Sergeant-at-Arms Kushan Jayarane and others who are in charge of Parliamentary security.

title: COPF questions discrimination of resident digital services providers
summary: The Committee on Public Finance (COPF) Chairman Harsha de Silva today questioned the discrimination of resident digital services providers.

title: Parliament suspended over court vacancies debate
summary: Parliament proceedings were temporarily suspended following a protest staged by the Opposition over its request for a debate on delays in filling vacancies in the Supreme Court and Court of Appeal.

title: Armed robbers break into Rural Bank, steal stash of gold jewellery
summary: A group of three unidentified individuals broke into a Rural Bank in the Koralaima area of Moragahahena early this morning (June 23), fleeing with a cache of gold jewellery stored in the bank’s vault.

title: COPF approves VAT Amendment Bill with conditions
summary: The Committee on Public Finance (COPF) has approved the Value Added Tax (VAT) (Amendment) Bill, subject to specific conditions imposed by the committee.

title: Iran, US finalise agreement on release of $12b in frozen assets
summary: Ghalibaf said the agreement followed preliminary arrangements in Qatar and was formally signed in Switzerland, says Al Jazeera.

title: Iran leave note of thanks in LA locker room after draw with Belgium
summary: Iran left a message in their SoFi Stadium locker room on Sunday thanking Los Angeles for its hospitality during the World Cup and saying they are leaving ‌with dignity after a 0-0 draw with Belgium kept alive their hopes of reaching the knockout stages.

title: 2026 World Cup Golden Boot Race Heats Up
summary: Messi leads with five goals as Mbappé and Haaland keep pace in a record-breaking battle for football’s most coveted individual prize.

title: High Court upholds Gnanasara Thera’s nine-month jail term
summary: Colombo High Court Judge Manjula Thilakaratne today rejected the appeal filed by Bodu Bala Sena General Secretary Ven. Galagodaaththe Gnanasara Thera and upheld the nine-month rigorous imprisonment sentence imposed by the Colombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: Questions raised over halted Wolbachia dengue project
summary: Questions have been raised over the fate of Sri Lanka’s pilot project involving the use of Wolbachia bacteria to control dengue, with specialist Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa claiming that the initiative was discontinued despite its potential benefits.

title: Dengue passes 1,000 cases daily
summary: Sri Lanka is experiencing an unprecedented surge in dengue infections, with more than 1,000 cases reported within a single day.
